blocks.text: A layout wraps pages with shared content. Its slot is the space for the selected page.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.

blocks.title: Share a layout

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A slot marks where caller-supplied content is displayed. Text inside a slot is fallback content when that slot is empty.
`NuxtPage` is where Nuxt places the route selected by the current address.
`NuxtLayout` wraps the current page in a chosen layout. The layout's slot holds the page content.

blocks.text: Pages appear between the shared header and footer.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Leave a slot in the layout. Without it, the page content has nowhere to appear.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a navigation link to the default layout.
